output.description: This is an indoor golf driving range simulator and entertainment center.

gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.640721 41.892756)',4326)::geography, 5000)
  AND p.leisure = 'golf_course'
  AND elev.z >= 140;

      p.geometry::geometry AS geom
    FROM pois p
    JOIN museum_geom m ON ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geometry, m.geom, 5000)
    WHERE p.leisure = 'golf_course'
  ) sub
),
elevation_check AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.poi_name,
    gc.geom,
    (ST_ValueCount(ST_Clip(r.rast, gc.geom, TRUE), 1)).val AS elevation
  FROM golf_courses gc
  JOIN public.dem_us r ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, gc.geom)
)
SELECT 
  poi_name
FROM elevation_check
WHERE elevation >= 140;
